capture.zh: 进入裂空星系泰若星二层丛林之境，点击右下角的鸟蛋出现皮特萨罗，战胜后获得一个皮特萨罗精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 用电系或冰系（雷伊、杜尼鲁）：魔龙消强并弱化 → 斯普林特自杀 → 雷伊雷神觉醒强化后致命一击秒杀。

engine_notes: Innate special-attack boost (天生特攻强化); magnitude not stated; +2, as unstated innate boosts are atk+2 (user decision 2026-10-19) (the source names special attack).
Below half HP the player's pets' accuracy drops (血量降至一半时我方精灵命中率下降); encoded as a one-time foe acc -1, magnitude/repeat unknown.
Weakening works but its skill 绝灭射线 removes its own stat drops; often uses 怒鸣.
skills: all four are named by a period guide (4399 2011-11-21) and equal species 997's last four at or below Lv65.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
